units.source_text: “离开学校以后，我也不曾在白天里看过那些樟树。”

en.t: “Since leaving school, I have never seen those camphor trees in the daytime either.”

units.source_text: 千重子说，“爸爸，您知道晚上游览车的路线吗？

en.t: Chieko said, “Father, do you know the route of the evening sightseeing bus?

units.source_text: 观光路线中安排了一个青莲院，游览车一开进去，就有几个和尚拎着提灯出来迎接。”

en.t: Shoren-in is included on the sightseeing route, and as soon as the bus drives in, several monks come out carrying lanterns to welcome it.”
